recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future validator download maintenance should happen in the Confluence tools/validator documentation rather than by reintroducing direct mutable validator JAR links in the core downloads page.
issue_request: FHIR-28368 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for R5. It asked to replace the FHIR-core downloads page link from https://storage.googleapis.com/ig-build/org.hl7.fhir.validator.jar to https://github.com/hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core/releases/latest/download/validator_cli.jar.
initial_application: Commit 021fdd52eec1b71a39014469ed6df9dbb3804995 changed source/downloads.html from the obsolete Google Storage validator JAR URL to the GitHub validator_cli.jar URL, applying the requested link correction.
additional_context: The issue came from the Zulip #implementers 'Validation Time' thread, where Shovan Roy reported the downloads-page validator link and Oliver Egger replied that he added Jira FHIR#28368 for the link. Later FHIR-31735 work, applied by 472abf78c495c2ae44924d499be7434ed50788d0 and already audited on the combined branch as 341047292ef9c95ffdcb2e96cf286ee421252d52, removed direct validator/tool rows from downloads.html and moved mutable tool guidance to Confluence registry links. source/hierarchy.xml confirms Downloads and Validating Resources are active built pages.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/downloads.html and source/validation.html link to the Confluence FHIR Tools Registry for tools and validators, and repository-wide source grep found no obsolete Google Storage validator URL or direct validator_cli.jar downloads-page link needing correction.
